archetypes.name: ci-delegate
archetypes.rationale: Agentic CI loop changes subprocess, push, and wait sequencing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the delegated CI fixer integration from parent evaluate_failure through ci_agentic_fix. Focus on cwd and --repo-root threading, RunContext reconstruction, passive ci wait parsing, and safe mapping back to FixResult. Check that rebase-pending paths do not re-enter the agentic loop. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: conflict-loop
archetypes.rationale: Conflict resolution no longer uses run_waterfall or version-file prepass.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review rebase conflict handling for explicit tier-loop parity with prior waterfall behavior. Focus on driver-owned staging, unmerged-path checks after each tier, health versus non-health launch failures, and unconditional pre-push handoff behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: lint-claude
archetypes.rationale: Lint-fix now launches write-capable Claude before existing external tools.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Claude lint-fix launcher and checks.py dispatch order. Focus on prompt scope, write permissions, forbidden-path and submodule guards, coder-owned commit acceptance parity, and token or diagnostic sidecar handling. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
